WITH evt AS ( -- 근무/휴가/당직 데이터 합치기 SELECT cc_code = Gu_Code1, cc_buser = CASE WHEN ISNULL(Gu_Code2,'') = '' THEN ISNULL(Id_Job,Gu_Ward) ELSE Gu_Code2 END, kk = DATEDIFF(DAY, CAST(#{searchFromDate} AS DATE), Gu_Date) + 1, cc_flag = CASE WHEN ISNULL(Du_Flag,'') = '' THEN Gu_Flag ELSE '당직' END, cc_chk = CASE WHEN #{searchKeyword} IN ('1') AND ISNULL(Gu_Code2,'') <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM I_GunMu LEFT JOIN I_Duty ON Du_Date = Gu_Date AND Gu_Code1 = Du_Code1 AND Du_Flag = 2 LEFT JOIN P_InsaDetail ON Id_Code = Gu_Code1 AND Id_DtFlag = 4 AND Id_Saflag = 1 AND Gu_Date BETWEEN Id_Date1 AND ISNULL(Id_Date2,'2099-12-31') WHERE Gu_Date BETWEEN CAST(#{searchFromDate} AS DATE) AND CAST(#{searchToDate} AS DATE) AND ( #{searchId} IS NULL OR #{searchId} = '' OR Gu_Code1 = #{searchId} )
UNION ALL
SELECT cc_code = Od_Code, cc_buser = ISNULL(Id_Job,''), kk = DATEDIFF(DAY, CAST(#{searchFromDate} AS DATE), Od_Date) + 1, cc_flag = CONVERT(VARCHAR(2),Od_OffFlag) + CONVERT(VARCHAR(2),Od_OffType), cc_chk = 0 FROM P_Offday LEFT JOIN P_InsaDetail ON Id_code = Od_Code AND Id_DtFlag = 4 AND Id_Saflag = 1 AND Od_Date BETWEEN Id_Date1 AND ISNULL(Id_Date2,'2099-12-31') WHERE Od_Date BETWEEN CAST(#{searchFromDate} AS DATE) AND CAST(#{searchToDate} AS DATE) AND Od_OffFlag <> '0' AND ( #{searchId} IS NULL OR #{searchId} = '' OR Od_Code = #{searchId} )
UNION ALL
SELECT cc_code = Du_Code1, cc_buser = ISNULL(Id_Job,''), kk = DATEDIFF(DAY, CAST(#{searchFromDate} AS DATE), Du_Date) + 1, cc_flag = '당직', cc_chk = 0 FROM I_Duty LEFT JOIN P_InsaDetail ON Id_Code = Du_Code1 AND Id_DtFlag = 4 AND Id_Saflag = 1 AND Du_Date BETWEEN Id_Date1 AND ISNULL(Id_Date2,'2099-12-31') WHERE #{searchKeyword} IN ('7') AND Du_Date BETWEEN CAST(#{searchFromDate} AS DATE) AND CAST(#{searchToDate} AS DATE) AND ( #{searchId} IS NULL OR #{searchId} = '' OR Du_Code1 = #{searchId} ) ), pvt AS ( -- 주간데이터를 월~일로 매핑 SELECT cc_code, cc_buser, cc_chk = MAX(cc_chk), a1 = MAX(CASE WHEN kk = 1 THEN cc_flag ELSE '' END), a2 = MAX(CASE WHEN kk = 2 THEN cc_flag ELSE '' END), a3 = MAX(CASE WHEN kk = 3 THEN cc_flag ELSE '' END), a4 = MAX(CASE WHEN kk = 4 THEN cc_flag ELSE '' END), a5 = MAX(CASE WHEN kk = 5 THEN cc_flag ELSE '' END), a6 = MAX(CASE WHEN kk = 6 THEN cc_flag ELSE '' END), a7 = MAX(CASE WHEN kk = 7 THEN cc_flag ELSE '' END) FROM evt WHERE kk BETWEEN 1 AND 7 GROUP BY cc_code, cc_buser ), emp AS ( -- 대상 직원 목록(직종/조건/재직기간/saCd) + 기본근무코드 SELECT Ic_Saflag = MAX(Ic_Saflag), Ic_Code = Ic_Code, Ic_Name = MAX(RTRIM(Ic_Name)), Ic_Buser = CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), ISNULL(Id_Job, Ic_Buser)), Ic_Buser1 = MAX(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), ISNULL(Id_Job, Ic_Buser))), Ic_Indate = MAX(Ic_Indate), Ic_Jikgub = MAX(CONVERT(VARCHAR(3), ISNULL(Id_Amount, Ic_Jikgub))), Ic_Jikchek = MAX(ISNULL(Id_Famname, Ic_Jikchek)), cc_Gunmu = MAX(ISNULL(Id_GunMu,'D-')), Ic_SaPhone = MAX(RTRIM(ISNULL(Ic_Saphone,''))), Sort = MAX(CASE WHEN Ic_Code IN ('190103','190104') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM P_InSaCode LEFT JOIN P_InsaDetail ON Id_code = Ic_code AND Id_DtFlag = 4 AND Id_Saflag = Ic_Saflag WHERE Id_Saflag < 3 AND Id_Date1 <= CAST(#{searchToDate} AS DATE) AND ISNULL(Id_Date2,'2099-12-31') >= CAST(#{searchFromDate} AS DATE) AND 1 = CASE WHEN #{searchKeyword} = '1' AND ISNULL(Id_Job, Ic_Buser) BETWEEN 200 AND 299 THEN 1 WHEN #{searchKeyword} = '2' AND ISNULL(Id_FamName, Ic_Jikchek) IN (25,26,27) THEN 1 WHEN #{searchKeyword} = '7' AND ISNULL(Id_FamName, Ic_Jikchek) IN (1) THEN 1 WHEN #{searchKeyword} = '9' AND ISNULL(Id_FamName, Ic_Jikchek) NOT IN (1,3,17,19,25,26,27) AND ISNULL(Id_Job, Ic_Buser) <> '110' AND ISNULL(Id_Job, Ic_Buser) NOT BETWEEN 200 AND 299 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AND ( #{searchId} IS NULL OR #{searchId} = '' OR Ic_Code = #{searchId} ) GROUP BY Ic_Code, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), ISNULL(Id_Job, Ic_Buser)) )
SELECT Chk = 0, e.Ic_Saflag, e.Ic_Code, e.Ic_Name, Ic_Buser = e.Ic_Buser, Ic_Buser1 = e.Ic_Buser1, e.Ic_Indate, Ic_ResNum = '', Ic_Jikgub = e.Ic_Jikgub, Ic_Jikchek = e.Ic_Jikchek, Flag = 7, tDate = CAST(#{searchFromDate} AS DATE), icHpPhone = ISNULL(dbo.GetPWChange_2('KGH2010','InsaCode',e.Ic_Code,'PhoneHp'),''), icSaPhone = CASE WHEN ISNULL(e.Ic_SaPhone,'') = '' THEN '' WHEN LEN(e.Ic_SaPhone) < 5 THEN '☏ ' + e.Ic_SaPhone ELSE e.Ic_SaPhone END,
a1 = ISNULL(p.a1,'') + CASE WHEN ISNULL(p.cc_chk,0)=1 AND ISNULL(p.a1,'')<>'' THEN 'ⓗ' ELSE '' END, a2 = ISNULL(p.a2,'') + CASE WHEN ISNULL(p.cc_chk,0)=1 AND ISNULL(p.a2,'')<>'' THEN 'ⓗ' ELSE '' END, a3 = ISNULL(p.a3,'') + CASE WHEN ISNULL(p.cc_chk,0)=1 AND ISNULL(p.a3,'')<>'' THEN 'ⓗ' ELSE '' END, a4 = ISNULL(p.a4,'') + CASE WHEN ISNULL(p.cc_chk,0)=1 AND ISNULL(p.a4,'')<>'' THEN 'ⓗ' ELSE '' END, a5 = ISNULL(p.a5,'') + CASE WHEN ISNULL(p.cc_chk,0)=1 AND ISNULL(p.a5,'')<>'' THEN 'ⓗ' ELSE '' END, a6 = ISNULL(p.a6,'') + CASE WHEN ISNULL(p.cc_chk,0)=1 AND ISNULL(p.a6,'')<>'' THEN 'ⓗ' ELSE '' END, a7 = ISNULL(p.a7,'') + CASE WHEN ISNULL(p.cc_chk,0)=1 AND ISNULL(p.a7,'')<>'' THEN 'ⓗ' ELSE '' END,
Filter = 1, cc_Gunmu = (SELECT Gc_Name + '(' + STUFF(Gc_Time1,3,0,':') + '~' + STUFF(Gc_Time2,3,0,':') + ')' FROM I_GunmuCode WHERE Gc_Code = ISNULL(e.cc_Gunmu,'D-')) FROM emp e LEFT JOIN pvt p ON e.Ic_Code = p.cc_code AND e.Ic_Buser1 = p.cc_buser ORDER BY e.Ic_Buser, e.Ic_Jikgub, e.Sort, e.Ic_Indate;

SELECT cc_Time, cc_RMK FROM ( SELECT cc_Time = CASE WHEN ISNULL(Ms_Time1,'') = '' THEN '' ELSE SUBSTRING(Ms_Time1,1,2)+':' + SUBSTRING(Ms_Time1,3,2) END, cc_RMK = Ms_Remark FROM I_MySchedule WHERE Ms_date = #{searchDate} AND Ms_Flag < 50 AND (Ms_UserID = #{userId} OR Ms_Flag = 1 OR Ms_BuserID IN (SELECT Buser FROM dbo.[GetSineBuser](#{userId})) OR Ms_BuserID = #{ccBuser}) UNION ALL SELECT cc_Time = SUBSTRING(Tn_time,1,2) + ':' + SUBSTRING(Tn_time,3,2), cc_RMK = tn_title FROM I_TotalNote WHERE Tn_delflag = '1' AND Tn_PlanDate = #{searchDate} UNION ALL SELECT cc_Time = SUBSTRING(Ul_InTime,1,2) + ':' + SUBSTRING(Ul_InTime,3,2), cc_RMK = RTRIM(Ul_Remark) + ' ' + CASE WHEN isnull(Ul_Count,0) = 0 THEN '' ELSE isnull(Ul_Count,0) + '명' END FROM I_UseList WHERE Ul_Date = #{searchDate} AND Isnull(Ul_Gongji,'N') = 'Y' UNION ALL SELECT cc_Time = '24:00', cc_RMK = 'BirthDay : ' + Ph_Name FROM I_Phonelist LEFT JOIN I_Lunar ON ((Ph_Birthflag = '1' AND RIGHT(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8),Ph_BirthDate,112),4) = RIGHT(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8),Lu_SolarDt,112),4)) OR (Ph_Birthflag = '2' AND Lu_Yun = 0 AND RIGHT(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8),Ph_BirthDate,112),4) = REPLACE(RIGHT(Lu_LunarDt,5),'-',''))) AND Lu_SolarDt = #{searchDate} WHERE Ph_Code = #{userId} AND Lu_SolarDt = #{searchDate} )TMP ORDER BY cc_Time

SELECT hc_Name, Du_Name = dbo.GetSaNm (Du_Code1) FROM ( SELECT Du_Flag,Du_Code1 FROM I_Duty WHERE Du_Date = CASE WHEN LEFT(CONVERT(time, GETDATE()),2) < '08' THEN DATEADD(DAY,-1, #{searchDate} ) ELSE #{searchDate} END AND Du_Flag NOT IN (9,10) UNION ALL SELECT Du_Flag = CASE WHEN Ic_Buser = '140' THEN '21' ELSE '22' END, Du_Code1 = Gu_Code1 FROM I_Gunmu LEFT JOIN P_InsaCode ON Ic_Code = Gu_Code1 WHERE Gu_Date = CASE WHEN LEFT(CONVERT(time, GETDATE()),2) < '08' THEN DATEADD(DAY,-1, #{searchDate} ) ELSE #{searchDate} END AND Ic_Jikchek = 35 AND LEFT(Gu_Flag,1) = 'N' )TMP LEFT JOIN I_HelpCD ON Hc_Code = 'Int000060' AND Hc_Seq = Du_Flag ORDER BY Hc_Filter

SELECT '오전' AS Hc_Name, ISNULL( (SELECT STRING_AGG(dbo.GetSaNm(Do_SaCD), ', ') FROM I_DocOutDuty WHERE Do_Date = #{searchDate} AND Do_AM = '1') , '') AS Du_Name UNION ALL SELECT '오후' AS Hc_Name, ISNULL( (SELECT STRING_AGG(dbo.GetSaNm(Do_SaCD), ', ') FROM I_DocOutDuty WHERE Do_Date = #{searchDate} AND Do_PM = '1') , '') AS Du_Name;
